name: IBM backside polysilicon gettering
description: In an IBM-assigned patent, Shih-Ming Hu described using a deposited layer of polycrystalline silicon on the back of a wafer to trap impurities during high-temperature processing of integrated circuits. The layer kept the impurity sink away from the front-side devices.

date.basis: Grant and publication date of US patent 4,053,335.

events.statement: Hu's patent disclosed the backside gettering method and reported tests including electrical measurements on MOS capacitors and a comparison of bipolar test structures made with and without the film.

evidence.locator: Front page; Fig. 1 and Examples 1 and 7
evidence.supports: Dates the original grant and describes the deposited backside film and reported device tests.

earliest_record.rationale: The granted patent is the earliest inspected public source for this method. The patent lists an earlier filing date.

research.note: Scope is the deposited polysilicon impurity sink documented by Hu. Chen and Silvestri later tested backside polysilicon in an epitaxial process.
